Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Further to our letter dated May 18, 2026 intimating the schedule of the group conference call for 
Friday, May 22, 2026, please find below the link of audio recording of the aforesaid conference call, 
held to discuss financial results for the fourth quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026 
pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. The same is also available on the 
website of the Company at www.eichermotors.com   
 
Link to access recording of conference call: https://www.eicher.in/quarterly-results 
 
You are requested to take the same on your records. 
 
Thanking you, 
For Eicher Motors Limited
